newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - ANI tops turnover with 5 pct traded.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - ANI tops turnover with 5 pct traded.

text.p: Heavy engineering group Australian National Industries Ltd (ANI) topped the turnover lists on Monday with about percent of the company's shares traded.
Brokers said Macquarie Equities handled the trade of 41 million ANI shares at A$1.27 per share. ANI shares were one cent lower at A$1.27 at 1.00 p.m. (0200 GMT).
ANI said it could not comment on the trade, while ANI shareholder Ross Palmer, who holds around five percent of ANI issued capital, was unavailable for comment.
By 1.05 p.m. (0205 GMT), 42.08 million ANI shares had changed hands.

Palmer, who inherited the ANI stake following the takeover of his former company Palmer Tube Mills Ltd last year by ANI, is currently involved in a stoush with the ANI board after his removal from the ANI board at last month's annual meeting.
